name: The Padang
note: Cricket green opposite the former City Hall and Supreme Court (National Gallery) and the Singapore Cricket Club; OSM w21587770 (leisure=pitch, 35,550 m2). Chinese 政府大厦大草场. Camera view: from the Esplanade side or the Cricket Club, the towers of Raffles Place behind.

name: Fort Canning Hill
note: Wooded hill over the river, summit ~48 m (OSM node ele 48; Fort Canning Park w16892550, 309,845 m2). Chinese 福康宁山. Not a building: a terrain feature the DEM already holds.

name: Boat Quay
note: Row of low shophouses on the river bend under the CBD towers; position from Wikidata Q4931498 [believed], not checked against a footprint. Chinese 驳船码头.

name: Clarke Quay
note: Riverside godowns with the canopy roofs, upstream of Boat Quay; Wikipedia/Wikidata coordinate. Chinese 克拉码头.

name: Tiong Bahru estate
note: 1930s Streamline Moderne SIT flats; Wikidata Q7808727 point (estate centre), outside the Marina Bay-CBD core. Chinese 中峇鲁.

name: Tanjong Pagar container terminal
note: Gantry cranes and container yards, being vacated for the Greater Southern Waterfront; APPROXIMATE position [believed] (MP2019 City Terminals subzone), not a footprint. Chinese 丹戎巴葛码头.

name: Mount Faber (Faber Point)
note: Hill with the cable car to Sentosa; Faber Point ele 106 m in OSM (w46671412), Wikipedia gives ~94-105 m for the hill; Mount Faber Park w343746558 (809,134 m2). Chinese 花柏山.

name: Resorts World Sentosa
note: Integrated resort and Universal Studios on Sentosa's north shore: a complex of many buildings, not one footprint; Wikidata Q5955134 point. Chinese 圣淘沙名胜世界.

name: Marina Barrage
note: Dam that turned Marina Bay into a freshwater reservoir, with the grass-roofed pump house (OSM w150819013, building=service, 22,276 m2, tourism=attraction, no height). A structure across the water, not a tall building. Chinese 滨海堤坝.
